lines.zh: 我迈开长腿，几步就跨过一片地。
lines.en: My long legs cross a stretch of ground in a few strides.
Big body, but a fast walk.

lines.zh: 我把湿泥踩成一串深坑。
lines.en: My feet leave a string of deep pits in the wet soil.

lines.zh: 我低着头走，像在找什么。
lines.en: I walk with my head low, as if searching.
I will trample this ground flat.

lines.zh: 壳上的水迹一路拖过去。
lines.en: A wet trail drags behind my shell.
I go around the stones to avoid stumbling.
Each step presses the earth down.

lines.zh: 这么高的身子，低头才看得见路。
lines.en: This tall, I must lower my head to see the path.

lines.zh: 我走得像在筑什么东西。
lines.en: I walk as if building something.

lines.zh: 脚边的小东西都让开了。
lines.en: The small things by my feet get out of the way.
I walk toward wherever there's water.
That marsh ahead will do.

lines.zh: 我抬手，把挡路的枝拨开。
lines.en: I raise an arm and push a branch aside.

lines.zh: 走了这么久，地面都变了样。
lines.en: After this long a walk, the ground looks different.

lines.zh: 长腿一步，湿沙陷下去半尺。
lines.en: One long stride sinks the wet sand half a foot.

lines.zh: 我站着，水从壳上往下淌。
lines.en: I stand, water running down my shell.
Up this high, the wind is strong.
I am growing, taller by the day.
This body is for the sea to use.

lines.zh: 背上开始鼓起新的东西。
lines.en: Something new is swelling on my back.

lines.zh: 我低下头，看了看自己的手。
lines.en: I lower my head and look at my own hands.

lines.zh: 站立的时候，感受最清楚。
lines.en: Standing still, I feel it most clearly.
This marsh will slowly become sea.

lines.zh: 我呼吸得很慢，一次很长。
lines.en: I breathe slowly, one long breath.
Something crawls beneath my plates.
I stay still, waiting for the tide.
The soil here is starting to smell of fish.
My feet sink deep into the mud.
A while longer and I'll be big enough.

lines.zh: 你只到我膝盖，别仰着头。
lines.en: You reach my knee. Do not crane your neck.
You're a bit shorter than my foot.

lines.zh: 我比你高两个头，抬头说话。
lines.en: I stand two heads taller. Look up when you speak.

lines.zh: 我给你留了一条路，走那条。
lines.en: I left you a path. Take it.

lines.zh: 你鞋底的泥，不是这里的。
lines.en: The mud on your soles is not from here.
No hurry. You can speak first.

lines.zh: 我抬头，其实是在看你身后。
lines.en: I raise my head, though I'm looking past you.
Little thing, where are you going?
This marsh is mine.

lines.zh: 你站着不动，我也就不动。
lines.en: Stand still and I'll stay still.
A white crack runs across my plates.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，地面塌了一块。
lines.en: I take half a step and the ground caves.
That one I have to acknowledge.
I lower my head to see the wound. Deep.
Water gushes from the crack.
I'm standing, just crooked.
My shell is still growing. It will fill in.

lines.zh: 你打得动我，说明你不小。
lines.en: If you can move me, you're not small.
Pain runs from the shell inward.
Not yet. I haven't fallen.
That wouldn't fill one mouthful.
I bend down and sniff at it.
I'll keep it and eat later.
Blood in seawater smells stronger than this.
I prefer what comes from the water.

lines.zh: 你举着它站在那里，很有耐心。
lines.en: You stand there holding it up. Patient.

lines.zh: 你放下，我等你退开再拿。
lines.en: Set it down; I wait for you to step back.
I reach out, careful not to knock you over.

lines.zh: 这么香的东西，从哪来的？
lines.en: Where did something this fragrant come from?
I press it into the mud to keep.

lines.zh: 被我撞到，你就飞出去了。
lines.en: Hit by me, you'd go flying.

lines.zh: 我收住脚，不然你站不住。
lines.en: I stop my foot, or you wouldn't stay standing.

lines.zh: 你撞到我的腿，像撞柱子。
lines.en: You hit my leg like a pillar.
Move aside. My stride is long.

lines.zh: 我一转身，就把你挤开了。
lines.en: One turn and I've pushed you aside.

lines.zh: 地上的坑，是我刚才踩的。
lines.en: Those pits on the ground are my footprints.
I lift a foot and step over you.

lines.zh: 你站在我影子里，凉快吧。
lines.en: You're in my shadow. Cooler, isn't it.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，泥土都溅了。
lines.en: We collide and mud splashes up.
I steady you. Don't move about.

lines.zh: 我这样的，也能被靠近吗？
lines.en: Can something like me be approached?
You stand so close, and I don't move.
In the marsh, we stay together.
I'm large. You'll have to bear with it.
I'll lay the road. You follow.

lines.zh: 这一片，会变成我们两个的。
lines.en: This area will be ours, both of ours.

lines.zh: 你的甲壳反光，像我认下的伴。
lines.en: Your shell shines like the mate I chose.
I'm not very gentle.

lines.zh: 等水涨上来，我们就在一起。
lines.en: When the water rises, we'll be together.
Don't go far. I can't see you.

lines.zh: 我两根手指就捏起来了。
lines.en: Two fingers are enough to lift it.

lines.zh: 这东西在我手里太小了。
lines.en: It's tiny in my hand.
I hold it in my palm, afraid to crush it.
You lost this.

lines.zh: 几丁质碎片，我一片片码好。
lines.en: I stack the chitin shards one by one.
There's more in the mud; I dig it out.
It's stuck to my hand.
I crouch and gather them slowly.

lines.zh: 这块珊瑚，我夹在腋下带走。
lines.en: I tuck this coral under my arm and carry it off.
These I'll take back. They're useful.
You're moving. I see it.
I lower myself to see you clearly.

lines.zh: 这条路上的东西，我不放过。
lines.en: Nothing on this road gets past me.

lines.zh: 你把泥踩乱了，我不喜欢。
lines.en: You've churned the mud. I dislike that.
I walk toward you, slowly.
The Nethersea Founder closes in two paces.

lines.zh: 深海在叫我，你站在那儿别动。
lines.en: The deep is calling; stand right there.
I raise an arm and close the road.
My kin are elsewhere. That's enough.
You still have a chance to run.
I follow, thirty feet a stride.

lines.zh: 我这身甲壳是从海里长的。
lines.en: This shell grew out of the sea.
I'm north of you, and I haven't moved.

lines.zh: 你的影子，现在在我脚下。
lines.en: Your shadow is under my feet now.
The more you hide, the narrower the road.
I don't need to hurry. I wait for the tide.

lines.zh: 这片湿地，出口只有一个。
lines.en: There's only one way out of this marsh.

lines.zh: 你走的那条路，是我开出来的。
lines.en: That path you're on — I made it.
You cannot outrun these long legs.
You'll stop eventually.
One stomp and the ground rings.
One sweep of my arm pushes you away.

lines.zh: 我这身重量，压下来就够。
lines.en: This weight alone is enough.
I pick you up and set you down.
The edge of my shell strikes hard.
I don't want to crush you.

lines.zh: 这一下是警告，下一脚不是。
lines.en: This was a warning. The next footfall won't be.
My arm rises slowly and falls fast.
Mud splashes up and blocks the view.
Go. Don't look back.
I rise from the water, very tall.
Two pits mark where I first stand.

lines.zh: 湿泥从我的壳上滑下来。
lines.en: Wet mud slides off my shell.
I rise taller than the trees around me.
This area is beginning to become sea.
I plant myself and look at the sky.
Water pours from the seams of my plates.

lines.zh: 湿地是我的第一个落脚点。
lines.en: The marsh is my first foothold.
I lift a hand and shake off the mud.

lines.zh: 我来了，路会一直铺下去。
lines.en: I'm here, and the road will keep spreading.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的甲，裂口冒白气。
lines.en: Fire bakes my shell; steam hisses from the cracks.

lines.zh: 我这一身，是深海垫底的。
lines.en: I am the foundation of the deep sea.

lines.zh: 水没过头顶，我倒不难受。
lines.en: Water closes over my head. It isn't unpleasant.
The blast spun me half around.
An arrow sticks in my seam like a barb.
That light made my shell contract.

lines.zh: 太久没吃东西，长不动了。
lines.en: Too long without food. I can't grow.

lines.zh: 雷落在肩甲，我跪进水里。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my shoulder plate; I kneel in the water.
No mud here. I can't get a foothold.
